component.name: Cycletron
component.summary: Live coding for music, built on Rust

ul.li: Code highlighting that follows the notes as they play
Stage mode: full-window visualizers driven by the pattern itself
Built-in drum machines, General MIDI and downloadable sample sets
MIDI input, Ableton Link and OSC
Export to WAV, MP3, stems or MIDI
An optional AI assistant, with your own API key or a local model

screenshot.caption: The editor, highlighting a synthwave arrangement as it plays
Stage mode with NEON CIRCUIT: one chip per track
Stage mode with FOREST DRIVE: every note plants a tree
Stage mode with COCKPIT: fly through the schedule
